case_studies.company: Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh
case_studies.summary: Rebuilding a scalable, accessible, and user-centric digital presence for global medical leaders
case_studies.challenge: Existing Drupal 7 platform was technically outdated, difficult to manage, and falling short of user and internal team needs. Over 14,500 Fellows and Members in 100+ countries.
case_studies.solution: Full design and build of new Drupal 10 website with DOX membership SSO, Moodle education platform integration, Eventbrite integration, modular accessible design system, and custom drag-and-drop page builder.
case_studies.results: Average session duration more than doubled. Bounce rates dropped by 9%. Editorial efficiency improved greatly — content teams now work independently with far less need for technical support.

faq.q: What CMS platforms do you work with?
faq.a: We specialise in Drupal and also work with WordPress and Drupal Commerce. We're an Acquia partner for enterprise hosting.
Yes — we offer flexible support packages covering maintenance, security updates, hosting, and continuous improvement.

faq.q: What sectors do you work with?
faq.a: Higher education, care industry, venues and suppliers, charities, research institutes, lifestyle and luxury brands, startups, and membership organisations.

faq.q: Can you help with digital marketing as well as development?
faq.a: Yes — we offer SEO, PPC (Google Ads), CRO, GA4 setup, and white-label services for other agencies.
We're based in Oxford, UK — Frieze Farmhouse, Woodstock Road, OX2 8JX. We work with clients across the UK and internationally.

faq.q: How do you use AI in your work?
faq.a: We use AI for image categorisation, alt text generation, content management, rapid prototyping, and SEO content strategy. We also offer AI consultation services.

faq.q: Can you work alongside our existing team?
faq.a: Absolutely. We regularly augment in-house teams with specialist skills — scaling up and down as needed without the cost of permanent hires.
